places.name: Great Barrier Reef
places.ai_summary: The Great Barrier Reef is the world's largest coral reef system, renowned for its vibrant marine life and stunning underwater landscapes. It's a UNESCO World Heritage site and a must-visit for snorkeling and diving enthusiasts.

opening_hours.notes: Tours operate seasonally.

places.place_tip: Book a snorkeling or diving tour to explore the reef up close.

attribution.title: ISS-45 StoryOfWater, Great Barrier Reef, Australia
attribution.author: NASA/Kjell Lindgren
attribution.description: "The Great Barrier Reef outlines the coast of Australia in turquoise and blue. The #StoryOfWater." - Kjell Lindgren

places.name: Daintree Rainforest
places.ai_summary: The Daintree Rainforest is one of the oldest rainforests in the world, offering lush greenery, unique wildlife, and serene walking trails. It's a UNESCO World Heritage site and a haven for nature lovers.

opening_hours.notes: Some areas may be closed during the wet season.

places.place_tip: Take a guided tour to learn about the unique flora and fauna.

attribution.title: Daintree National Park
attribution.author: User:Diliff
attribution.description: A typical tropical rainforest scene in Daintree National Park

places.name: Gold Coast Beaches (Surfers Paradise)
places.ai_summary: The Gold Coast Beaches, including Surfers Paradise, are famous for their golden sands, surf waves, and vibrant nightlife. It's a hotspot for beach lovers and water sports enthusiasts.

opening_hours.notes: Lifeguard services from 06:00 to 18:00.

places.place_tip: Visit the beach early morning or late afternoon to avoid crowds.
places.address: Surfers Paradise, Gold Coast, Queensland, Australia

places.name: Whitsunday Islands
places.ai_summary: The Whitsunday Islands are a group of 74 islands in the heart of the Great Barrier Reef, known for their white sandy beaches, crystal clear waters, and stunning coral reefs. It's a paradise for sailors, snorkelers, and beach lovers.

opening_hours.notes: Access by boat or plane only.

places.place_tip: Take a boat tour to explore the islands and snorkel in the coral reefs.

places.name: Fraser Island (K'gari)
places.ai_summary: Fraser Island, also known as K'gari, is the world's largest sand island, featuring stunning beaches, rainforests, and unique wildlife. It's a UNESCO World Heritage site and a popular destination for 4WD adventures and eco-tourism.

opening_hours.notes: 4WD permits required for vehicle access.

places.place_tip: Join a guided 4WD tour to explore the island's highlights.

attribution.title: Indian Head view on Fraser Island (May 2016)
attribution.author: Rhain
attribution.description: A view of the beach from Indian Head, on Fraser Island in Queensland, Australia.

places.name: Australia Zoo
places.ai_summary: Australia Zoo, founded by Steve Irwin, is a world-renowned zoo located in Beerwah, Queensland. It's famous for its conservation efforts and up-close animal encounters, including kangaroos, koalas, and crocodiles.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Christmas Day.

places.place_tip: Attend the animal feeding sessions and shows for an enhanced experience.

attribution.title: Aus zoo sign
attribution.author: Kaus at English Wikipedia
attribution.description: picture of sign near entrance of australia zoo.

places.name: Cairns Esplanade
places.ai_summary: The Cairns Esplanade is a popular waterfront promenade in Cairns, Queensland, featuring a swimming lagoon, sandy beach, and lush parklands. It's an ideal spot for relaxation, picnics, and enjoying the tropical climate.

opening_hours.notes: Lifeguard services at the swimming lagoon from 09:00 to 17:00.

places.place_tip: Enjoy a stroll or bike ride along the esplanade, and don't miss the night markets.

places.name: South Bank Parklands (Brisbane)
places.ai_summary: The South Bank Parklands is a vibrant precinct in Brisbane, featuring gardens, walking paths, and recreational areas along the Brisbane River. It's a popular spot for both locals and tourists to relax and enjoy cultural events.

opening_hours.notes: Some facilities may have different opening hours.

places.place_tip: Visit the weekend markets and enjoy a swim at the Streets Beach.
places.address: South Bank Parklands, Brisbane, Queensland, Australia

attribution.description: Streets Beach at South Bank Parklands, Brisbane

places.name: Lone Pine Koala Sanctuary
places.ai_summary: Lone Pine Koala Sanctuary is the world's first and largest koala sanctuary, located in Brisbane, Queensland. It's dedicated to the conservation of Australian wildlife and offers visitors the chance to see and interact with koalas, kangaroos, and other native animals.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Christmas Day.

places.place_tip: Participate in the koala feeding session for a memorable experience.
places.address: Lone Pine Koala Sanctuary, Brisbane, Queensland, Australia

places.name: Noosa Heads
places.ai_summary: Noosa Heads is a coastal town in Queensland, known for its stunning beaches, national park, and vibrant dining scene. It's a popular destination for beachgoers, nature lovers, and food enthusiasts.

opening_hours.notes: National Park open from 07:00 to 19:00.

places.place_tip: Explore the Noosa National Park and enjoy the local seafood restaurants.

places.name: Kuranda Scenic Railway
places.ai_summary: The Kuranda Scenic Railway is a historic railway in Queensland, offering a picturesque journey through the rainforest, mountains, and waterfalls. It's a popular attraction for visitors to Cairns and the surrounding region.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Christmas Day.

places.place_tip: Combine your visit with the Skyrail Rainforest Cableway for a complete experience.

places.name: Skyrail Rainforest Cableway
places.ai_summary: The Skyrail Rainforest Cableway is a scenic gondola lift in Queensland, offering breathtaking views of the rainforest, mountains, and Coral Sea. It's an iconic experience for visitors to Cairns and the Great Barrier Reef region.

opening_hours.notes: Weather permitting; closed during severe weather conditions.

places.place_tip: Book a sunrise or sunset ride for a magical experience.

places.name: Glass House Mountains National Park
places.ai_summary: The Glass House Mountains National Park is a protected area in Queensland, featuring a series of striking volcanic mountains and rich biodiversity. It's a popular destination for hiking, rock climbing, and nature observation.

opening_hours.notes: Camping permitted in designated areas.

places.place_tip: Bring plenty of water and snacks, and wear sturdy shoes for hiking.
places.address: Glass House Mountains National Park, Queensland, Australia

places.name: Whitehaven Beach
places.ai_summary: Whitehaven Beach is a stunning beach located on Whitsunday Island, known for its pure white silica sand and crystal clear turquoise waters. It's often ranked among the top beaches in the world and is a must-visit in the Whitsundays.

opening_hours.notes: Access by boat or seaplane only.

places.place_tip: Visit early in the morning or late afternoon to avoid the heat and crowds.
places.address: Whitehaven Beach, Whitsunday Island, Queensland, Australia

attribution.title: Whitehaven Beach, Whitsunday Island, Queensland
attribution.author: Slug69
attribution.description: Whitehaven Beach on Whitsunday Island, Queensland

places.name: Brisbane River
places.ai_summary: The Brisbane River is the longest river in South East Queensland, winding through the city of Brisbane. It's popular for river cruises, kayaking, and scenic walks along the riverbanks.

opening_hours.notes: Cruise and kayak rentals have specific operating hours.

places.place_tip: Take a river cruise for a unique perspective of the city.

places.name: Theme Parks (Movie World, Sea World, Wet'n'Wild)
places.ai_summary: The Gold Coast is home to several major theme parks, including Movie World, Sea World, and Wet'n'Wild. These parks offer a variety of attractions, shows, and experiences for visitors of all ages.
places.name_english: Theme Parks (Movie World, Sea World, Wet'n'Wild)

opening_hours.notes: Hours may vary depending on the season and weather.

places.place_tip: Check the park maps and show schedules upon arrival.

places.name: Lamington National Park
places.ai_summary: Lamington National Park is a World Heritage-listed park in Queensland, known for its lush rainforests, waterfalls, and diverse wildlife. It's a popular destination for hiking, birdwatching, and nature photography.

opening_hours.notes: Camping permitted in designated areas.

places.place_tip: Visit the park's information center for maps and advice on walking trails.

attribution.title: Lamington NP 1 Stevage
attribution.author: Steve Bennett
attribution.description: Scenery on the Ship's Stern Circuit walk in Lamington National Park.

places.name: Port Douglas
places.ai_summary: Port Douglas is a coastal town in Far North Queensland, known for its luxury resorts, beautiful beaches, and proximity to the Great Barrier Reef. It's a popular destination for snorkeling, diving, and relaxation.

opening_hours.notes: Some attractions may have specific opening hours.

places.place_tip: Explore the local markets and enjoy a sunset cruise.

attribution.title: Port douglas qld australia
attribution.author: Malcolmj
attribution.description: Four Mile Beach, Port Douglas, Queensland, Australia.

places.name: Story Bridge Adventure Climb
places.ai_summary: The Story Bridge Adventure Climb is a guided climbing experience in Brisbane, offering panoramic views of the city, Brisbane River, and surrounding mountains. It's an exhilarating way to see Brisbane from a different perspective.

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Christmas Day.

places.place_tip: Wear comfortable clothing and closed-toe shoes for the climb.

places.name: QAGOMA (Queensland Art Gallery | Gallery of Modern Art)
places.ai_summary: QAGOMA is a major cultural precinct in Brisbane, comprising the Queensland Art Gallery and the Gallery of Modern Art. It features an extensive collection of Australian and international art, and regularly hosts major exhibitions and events.
places.name_english: QAGOMA (Queensland Art Gallery | Gallery of Modern Art)

opening_hours.notes: Closed on Good Friday and Christmas Day.

places.place_tip: Check the exhibition schedule and consider joining a guided tour.
